qol: Tooltip style is selectable in the config file.
getting_started: Hover over a tool or armor piece.
editor_notes: Works without a server install. Style default unknown.
name: Durability Tooltip
summary: Adds a durability line to item tooltips in one of three styles: numbers (e.g. 120 / 250), a bar, or text (Pristine, Slightly damaged, Severely damaged, Nearly broken, Broken).
